speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Parkinsonism (secondary to Risperidone use).

Based on your recent improvement on risperidone, I suspect your new movement disorder is a side effect of the medication. Can you describe whether your movements feel like stiffness, tremors, or a slowing of your limbs?
